annotations.title: Poll my events (outbox) with a cursor

description: Poll my events (outbox) with a cursor. Events are ordered so that a poller resuming from the cursor never skips an event, even when transactions commit out of order.

cursor.description: Resume point from the previous poll; omit to start at the oldest retained event.

since.description: Deprecated time-based polling (RFC3339 or unix seconds), used only without cursor; can miss late commits.
